clue.text: Block benefit covering married pub employee

indicators.note: the block-and-benefit pair spreads over and encloses the married abbreviation

parts.note: to bar is to block
aid is help or benefit

explanation.surface: Some welfare payment wraps round a married worker at the local.
explanation.definitionFit: She serves drinks behind the counter of a pub, so she is one of its staff.

clue.text: More infamous military HQ overlooking river

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits above the second, as if looking over it

parts.note: a base is a military headquarters

explanation.surface: An army headquarters towering above a river has a rather shady reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: Base means low or ignoble, so the comparative describes something more disreputable.

clue.text: Possible Trotskyist doing the rounds?

definitions.meaning: a Trotskyist is one kind of radical seeking to overthrow a political order
something that goes round and round, rotating like a wheel

explanation.surface: Is a Trotsky follower someone who circulates a lot?
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a political insurgent and something turning in circles, as revolutions are rotations.

clue.text: Girl primarily arranging nightly entertainment around N Ireland

indicators.note: the picked letters go round the Northern Ireland abbreviation
primarily means take the leading letter of each of the three following words

parts.note: NI is the abbreviation for Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A young woman organises evening shows somewhere in Ulster.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a female first name, so a fair example of a girl; also the musical's orphan heroine.

clue.text: Make lower enclosure by river

indicators.note: by means next to, so the two pieces sit side by side

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain, running through Chester and Aberdeen
a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: Instructions to sink a sheepfold down beside a riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: To dig further down into a hole or channel lowers its bottom.

clue.text: Soft sweet? An unsatisfactory compromise

definitions.meaning: a soft confection of sugar, butter and milk
a botched settlement that avoids the real issue

explanation.surface: Is a chewy candy just a feeble middle-way deal?
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a soft toffee-like confection and a makeshift fudging of a decision.

clue.text: Predict sound made by class in low stream

indicators.note: what follows is something said aloud, and the entry is what it sounds like

parts.note: a school class such as 4C: year four, in the C stream, a lower ability set

explanation.surface: Forecast the noise coming from a lower-ability school class.
explanation.walkthrough: British schools label classes by year and stream, so 4C is a fourth-year class in a lower set; said aloud, four-C gives the entry.
explanation.definitionFit: To foresee is to see ahead, which is to forecast what will happen.

clue.text: Resolve to put off motorway race

parts.note: to deter is to discourage or put off
the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI in crosswords
a nation is a people or race

explanation.surface: Someone decides to postpone a motorway race.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the motorway from London to Leeds, read here as the letters MI.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolve as a noun is firmness of purpose, a synonym of the answer.

clue.text: Show former husband one part of harness

parts.note: ex means former
I is the Roman numeral for one
the bit is the mouthpiece of a horse's harness

explanation.surface: An instruction to display an ex-husband's piece of horse tack.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhibit is to display or put on show.

clue.text: Oddly cheery native's tendency towards infidelity

indicators.note: oddly means in a strange way, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cheerful local has a wandering eye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oddly' looks like a call for alternate letters, but it is an anagram signal working on all of CHEERY NATIVES.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase, from the Marilyn Monroe film, is the supposed urge to stray after years of marriage.

clue.text: Take over from magistrate, about 51

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the magistrate goes round the number

parts.note: a reeve was a medieval local magistrate or official
LI is 51 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A JP of about fifty-one hands over his duties.
explanation.definitionFit: To relieve someone on duty is to replace them and take over their post.

clue.text: Eg Daphne's quiet massage

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
a rub is a massage

explanation.surface: A woman named Daphne is having a peaceful massage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Daphne' looks like a person; it is the flowering bush, and the 's is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Daphne is a genus of flowering bushes, so an example of a woody plant.

clue.text: Maker of ceramics — Harry, possibly

definitions.meaning: someone who throws and fires pots
Harry is the boy wizard of the J K Rowling books, bearing this surname

explanation.surface: A pottery maker who might be called Harry.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a ceramicist's trade name and the boy wizard's surname.

clue.text: Winged horse in Winnipeg as usual

indicators.note: in means the letters lie within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A flying horse appears in the Canadian city, as it always does.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the winged steed of Greek myth, sprung from Medusa's blood.

clue.text: Overshadow East European absorbing extracts from films.

indicators.note: absorbing means taking in, so the two E pieces close round the extracts

parts.note: clips are short extracts from films

explanation.surface: A man from eastern Europe outshines others by watching film clips.
explanation.definitionFit: To eclipse something is to outshine it and throw it into shadow.

clue.text: One's bound by others to put up a fight

indicators.note: bound by means held inside, so the others piece wraps round

parts.note: the rest are the others
one's read as one is, so I plus S

explanation.surface: A captive tied up by fellow prisoners will fight back.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to oppose or fight against something.

clue.text: Confusion getting woman on edge

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed above, so the woman comes first

parts.note: May is a woman's name
a hem is the edge of a garment

explanation.surface: Feeling muddled, a woman is on edge.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaos and disorder are synonyms of the answer.

clue.text: Get bigger medal at last, but react gruffly

parts.note: to grow is to get bigger

indicators.note: at last means take the final letter of the word medal

explanation.surface: Someone wants a bigger medal, but at the end grunts at the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A gruff, snarling noise of displeasure is a sound dogs and grumps make.

clue.text: Clap a very quiet youth outside university

parts.note: pp is pianissimo, very quiet in music

indicators.note: outside means the youth goes round the university letter

parts.note: a lad is a youth

explanation.surface: A hushed young man claps quietly outside the university.
explanation.definitionFit: To clap one's hands is to show approval by applause.

clue.text: Certification only initially accepted by senior academic

indicators.note: accepted by means taken in by, so the professor surrounds the picked letter

parts.note: prof is short for professor, a senior academic

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of the word only

explanation.surface: Only a professor can sign off on the certificate.
explanation.definitionFit: Proof is evidence that confirms something, which is what a certification provides.

clue.text: Child's word for pet, extremely gangly, with tail

parts.note: to tail someone is to follow them, to dog them

indicators.note: extremely means take the two outermost letters of gangly

explanation.surface: A toddler's name for a lanky pet with a tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tail' looks like a noun belonging to the pet, but it is the verb meaning follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Nursery talk for a puppy or hound, as small children say it.

clue.text: Marksman's activity has quick-witted son in fits

parts.note: sharp means quick-witted
in fits of laughter, hooting

explanation.surface: A sniper's shooting has his clever boy in stitches.
explanation.definitionFit: A marksman's skill lies in shooting accurately at targets.

clue.text: Elegance of ancient writing-instrument

definitions.meaning: a stylus, the pointed tool for writing on wax tablets, also has this name

explanation.surface: The grace of an old pen.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means panache and is also an old name for the stylus used for scratching letters.

clue.text: Your's truly's supporter, extremely wacky Welsh girl

parts.note: yours truly means me, so its possessive is my
a fan is a supporter

indicators.note: extremely means take the outermost letters of the word wacky

explanation.surface: The writer's admirer is a rather zany girl from Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a Welsh female first name, famous from the song and the Dylan Thomas reference.
